topic.title: Accordion
topic.shortdesc: Build vertically collapsing accordions in combination with Bootstrap’s Collapse JavaScript plugin.

section.title: How it works
section.p: The accordion uses collapse internally to make it collapsible. To render an accordion that’s expanded, add open="yes" to expand the relevant accordion-item .

section.title: Example
section.p: Click the accordions below to expand/collapse the accordion content.

section.title: Accordion Item #1
section.p: This is the first item’s accordion body. It is shown by default, until the collapse plugin adds the appropriate classes that we use to style each element. These classes control the overall appearance, as well as the showing and hiding via CSS transitions. You can modify any of this with custom CSS or overriding Bootstrap’s default variables.

section.title: Accordion Item #2
section.p: This is the second item’s accordion body. It is hidden by default, until the collapse plugin adds the appropriate classes that we use to style each element. These classes control the overall appearance, as well as the showing and hiding via CSS transitions. You can modify any of this with custom CSS or overriding Bootstrap’s default variables.

section.title: Flush
section.p: Set flush="yes" to remove the default background-color, some borders, and some rounded corners to render accordions edge-to-edge with their parent container.

section.title: Always open
section.p: Set open="yes" to make accordion items stay open when another item is opened.
